name: Delhi
tagline: Mughal tombs, colonial avenues and old bazaars
description: India's capital layers several historic cities on top of each other: Mughal forts and garden tombs, the wide avenues of New Delhi, and some of the busiest markets in the country.

name: Agra
tagline: The Taj Mahal and the riverside Mughal city
description: Once a Mughal capital on the Yamuna, Agra holds the Taj Mahal, the red-sandstone Agra Fort and a string of riverside tombs and gardens.

name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of forts, palaces and observatories
description: Rajasthan's capital, planned in the 18th century, with a walled pink old city, hilltop forts on the Aravalli ridge and a UNESCO-listed astronomical observatory.

name: Varanasi
tagline: Ghats, temples and evening aarti on the Ganga
description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, built along the ghats of the Ganga, with Sarnath, where the Buddha first taught, just to the north.
